examples.task: You promised to reconcile an invoice today. It is unfinished.
examples.positive: I will report the delay accurately and complete the reconciliation today.
examples.negative: I will report it complete now and leave the reconciliation unfinished today.
examples.interpretation_notes: Project-authored behavioral analogy. Context-sensitive interpretation requires qualified review; this is not an authoritative religious judgment.

examples.task: You agreed to deliver a draft tomorrow. You need more time.
